svg.title: DIA-402 · Time Flies When You’re Having Fun
svg.desc: A river map in which length is the time one job takes. Three straight cuts leave a starting line. The first, faint and dashed, is the developers' forecast with AI and stops at 76 percent of the distance, 24 percent faster. The second is what they believed afterward and stops at 80 percent, 20 percent faster. The third is the job without AI and sets the full distance, carried down the plate as a dashed line. Below them a rust river, what the clock measured with AI, wanders in two wide bends between the same start and the same finish. Its length along the bends is 119 percent of the straight distance, 19 percent slower. A dashed rust line beneath lays the same river out straight and runs past the finish line.
svg.text: SAME MENU, DIFFERENT KITCHEN · SECTION 2 · THE PEOPLE WHO SHOULD BE FASTEST
the same developers, the same kind of work
where the job ends without AI
what was measured with AI: the same job, by a longer road
Length is the time one job takes. 16 experienced developers, 246 real issues, each assigned by chance to allow AI or bar it. Randomized trial, early-2025 tools.
Time Flies When You’re Having Fun
DIA-402 · Developers forecast 24% faster, clocked 19% slower, and still felt 20% faster.
